Three defects. The DOMINATE was gated on FLAG_SET 'BLOOD_DEBT_FLAG', and Blood Debt is a PRINTED KEYWORD with nothing to do with the condition -- the card says 'if a card with 6 OR MORE {p} is banished this way'. That flag was set by a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches, so dominate could never apply; had the static run it would have applied ALWAYS. And the cost was BANISH_NAMED_GRAVEYARD_OPTIONAL -- 'you MAY banish a NAMED card' -- where the card says banish 3 RANDOM cards, mandatorily. The cost now records what it banished so the power test has something to read.

FOURTH DEFECT, found by the all-keyword sweep: the card PRINTS Dominate, so the engine granted it unconditionally and the 6-power gate was decoration -- Writhing Beast Hulk had dominate whatever it banished. The keyword is DECLARED conditional rather than converted to the WHILE_STATIC shape, and that is forced: the power test reads a REF the cost stores, refs are scoped to ONE ability execution (context.push_refs), and the cost has to stay on this ability for the ref to still exist when the condition is evaluated. Moving the cost to card level would pay it in play.py, outside that scope, and the ref would be gone by the time anything could read it.
